sentences: CNFs and DNFs combine clauses or terms through two layers of Boolean operations.
The source asks for pseudorandom generators with sub-log-squared seed length that fool polynomial-size formulas of these types.
A generator must preserve acceptance probabilities across many overlapping clauses despite using far fewer random bits.
Improving the seed would sharpen derandomization for basic Boolean tests and reduce exhaustive seed-enumeration costs.
